## About
The Forum Pub is the oldest bar in Richardson, up on the upper deck of the Shops at Promenade on North Coit Road. It started as a neighborhood social club and still feels like one, with a pool hall, darts and Golden Tee.
Daniel hosts karaoke on Mondays, CT Davis hosts the Powerhouse Blues Jam, and there are drink specials every day of the week. We appreciate military, first responders and service industry folks every day. Neighbors have given us 4.5 stars across 232 Google reviews.

## Services
- Pool, darts and Golden Tee: A pool hall, dartboards and Golden Tee for a game after work or a long night with friends.
- Karaoke with Daniel: Monday karaoke with host Daniel. One reviewer called him one of the best KJs you'll find.
- Powerhouse Blues Jam: A blues jam night hosted by CT Davis.
- Free pool on Tuesdays: $5 Crown and Down on Tuesdays, plus free pool all day with a drink purchase. ($5 Crown and Down)
- Sunday happy hour: All day happy hour on Sunday with $2 Budweiser and Miller Lite drafts. ($2 draft)

## FAQ
Q: Where are you located?
A: On the upper deck of the Shops at Promenade, on North Coit Road in Richardson.

Q: Is there a ladies' night?
A: Yes, Saturdays are Lady's Night.

## What customers say
- "Not gonna lie, I have a soft spot for this place. Beer selection is very limited but I like what I get. They have a cook come in often and he does a great job, but it’s not a certainty that he’ll be there. Bartenders  are great. Now, karaoke, Monday and Thursday, Daniel is one of the best KJs you’ll find and the participation is ludicrously good and wildly varied. I love it and try to get there a couple times if I’m in town on business." (Bryan, 5/5)
- "We only had fries, but they were seasoned so yummy and super hot. The bartender and cook were so fun and sweet! The karaoke host was great,  every single singer was just amazing!!! We had the time of our lives!!! I am absolutely in love with this bar,  I'm making it my new home- away- from- home! I cannot wait to go back!" (CeeCee Black, 5/5)
- "One of the best dive bars in dallas right now. They have been open rain or snow. They serve food and have pool and amazing service and they are super mask friendly so everyone is reallt safe! Did I mention that at certain times they have free food" (Ashley Blake, 5/5)
- "The forum pub has an excellent environment for beer after work. I work close to The Forum Club and go here for drink sometimes. They have pool and great variety of beers. The bartenders are friendly and fun." (Ashish Mainali, 5/5)
